verdict: Leads surged this week; now the focus is converting them.
narrative: The last 28 days brought 19 leads through Meta at a cost of $92.93 per lead, with 11 of those arriving in just the final three days of the period — a real and confirmed surge. Google contributed 11 separate conversions alongside that activity, and total organic engagement across your Google Business profiles reached 126 actions. The lead volume is welcome, but your intake process needs to keep pace: the open role on the lead-response side means speed-to-lead is slower than it should be, and that is being addressed now. Heading into the heating season, the goal is to ensure every inbound lead is captured and followed up on before budgets scale further in October.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, all through Meta, at $92.93 each
leads arrived in just the last three days of the period — the surge is recent
total actions taken on your Google Business profiles this period (calls, directions, website clicks)

watch_item.issue: Incoming leads are outpacing your intake capacity, with the lead-response role currently vacant and heating campaigns entering their busiest window.
watch_item.fix: Filling that intake seat and activating the speed-to-lead automation are the immediate priorities so no lead from the surge goes cold.
